prop-renamed:cw-button:loading->busy.title: loading → busy
prop-renamed:cw-button:loading->busy.guide: Replace `loading` (boolean) with `busy: { pending: boolean; progress?: number }`. Set `busy.pending` where you previously passed `loading`.

event-renamed:cw-button:loadingChange->b.title: loadingChange → busyChange
event-renamed:cw-button:loadingChange->b.guide: Listen for `busyChange` and read `event.busy` (boolean) instead of `event.loading`.

slot-removed:cw-tree:guide.title: guide slot removed
slot-removed:cw-tree:guide.guide: The experimental `guide` slot was removed; indent guides are controlled via CSS variables.

prop-removed:cw-tree:guides.title: guides prop removed
prop-removed:cw-tree:guides.guide: The boolean `guides` prop is removed. Indent guides are now always rendered through CSS; remove the attribute.
